mapper.update: MERGE INTO EMAIL_VERIFY t USING (SELECT #{email} AS EMAIL FROM dual) s ON (t.EMAIL = s.EMAIL AND t.VERIFIED_AT IS NULL) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.VERIFY_CODE = #{code}, t.EXPIRED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{expiredAtMinutes}, 'MINUTE'), t.MEMBER_ID = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( VERIFY_ID, MEMBER_ID, EMAIL, VERIFY_CODE, EXPIRED_AT, VERIFIED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_EMAIL_VERIFY.NEXTVAL, NULL, #{email}, #{code}, SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{expiredAtMinutes}, 'MINUTE'), NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EMAIL_VERIFY WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND VERIFIED_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRED_AT >= SYSTIMESTAMP ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual
